def transform(g):
 bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in g for x in row))
 # Keep the largest 4-connected non-background component.
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); components=[]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if g[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
   q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
   while q:
    a,b=q.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
    for x,y in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
     if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen:
      seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
   components.append(comp)
   
   
   
 if not components: return [row[:] for row in g]
 keep=set(max(components,key=len))
 return [[v if v==bg or (r,c) in keep else bg for c,v in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(g)]

# Demo example: 24x21 background 4 with non-background pixels; form the described shape.
demo=[[4]*21 for _ in range(24)]
coords=[(12,18),(13,17),(13,18),(13,19),(13,20),(14,17),(14,18),(14,19),(14,20),(15,17),(15,18),(15,19),(16,17),(16,18),(17,18),(17,19),(17,20)]
for r,c in coords: demo[r][c]=0
pred=transform(demo)
print(sum(v!=4 for row in pred for v in row), [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(pred) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=4])

def transform(g):
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in g for x in row))
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] != bg:
                out[r + 1][c] = g[r][c]
    return out
# Demo 2 exact check: pixels at (3,8),(4,9),(5,10) become rows 4,5,6.
d2=[[1]*17 for _ in range(28)]
for r,c in [(3,8),(4,9),(5,10)]: d2[r][c]=2
p2=transform(d2)
assert [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(p2) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]==[(4,8),(5,9),(6,10)]
# Demo 1 preserves the whole shape while translating it down one row.
d1=[[4]*21 for _ in range(24)]
coords1=[(12,18),(13,17),(13,18),(13,19),(13,20),(14,17),(14,18),(14,19),(14,20),(15,17),(15,18),(15,19),(16,17),(16,18),(17,18),(17,19),(17,20)]
for r,c in coords1:d1[r][c]=0
p1=transform(d1)
assert {(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(p1) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0}=={(r+1,c) for r,c in coords1}
